title: Corona
lyrics:
[00:35.36] The people will survive
[00:42.56] In their environment
[00:49.94] The dirt, scarcity and the emptiness
[00:55.31] Of our South
[01:00.67] The injustice of our greed
[01:07.91] The practice we inherit
[01:15.52] The dirt, scarcity and the emptiness
[01:20.85] Of our South
[01:26.34] There on the beach
[01:33.61] I could see it in her eyes
[01:41.15] I only had a Corona
[01:46.28] Five-cent deposit
[01:49.34]
